title: AWS Lambda to SES
description: Creates a Lambda function that sends an email with Amazon SES.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: When invoked, Lambda sends an email to Amazon SES. You can customize the email based on the needs of your application by supplying the function with the event contents.

The email address of the sender ('from') is provided in the AWS SAM deployment. This email message can contain both plain text and HTML content. The body and subject of the email message are passed into the function as an event. The receiver email address is also supplied in the event.
